definitions.deficit: points behind before the event, binned 1–3 / 4–6 / 7–10 / 11+
definitions.time: minutes left in the fourth quarter, binned 9–12 / 6–9 / 3–6 / 0–3 (0–3 includes 3:00)
definitions.three_share: three-point attempts / field-goal attempts of the trailing team
definitions.shots_per_min: trailing-team field-goal attempts per minute spent trailing in the cell
definitions.turnovers_per_min: trailing-team turnovers per minute spent trailing in the cell
definitions.fg_pct: made field goals / field-goal attempts of the trailing team
definitions.comeback_rate: share of distinct trailing team-games in the cell whose team won (overtime included)
definitions.exposure_seconds: game-clock seconds in which a team trailed by the cell deficit inside the cell time window
